deviations.description: Re-run install-extension.sh for cslib and literature
deviations.reason: install-extension.sh's merge_index_entries function (an unrelated side effect that runs automatically as part of the script, not something Phase 1 asked to modify) transiently dropped one pre-existing context/index.json entry (project/neovim/domain/extension-deploy-modes.md) during the cslib merge step for reasons not fully root-caused (a faithful sandbox replica of the same jq logic did not reproduce the drop). Detected via a before/after git-diff of all entry paths in context/index.json, which showed exactly one unexpected removal alongside the 15 expected cslib additions. Manually restored the exact original JSON object for the dropped entry (verified byte-for-byte from git show HEAD) rather than attempting to fix the underlying merge_index_entries script, since that function is out of this task's declared scope (context/index.json is a merge_targets output explicitly excluded from the new orphan checks per the plan and research report).
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — restored one entry the merge step transiently dropped; root cause not fixed, out of scope)*
